chunks: We have sent down to you a Book which has a reminder for you. Do you not understand?
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Quran being a reminder for humanity according to Surah Al-Anbiya?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'your mention' (dhikurukum) is often interpreted as referring to the Prophet Muhammad and the Ahl al-Bayt, signifying that the Quran serves as the eternal record of their spiritual authority and honor. This verse underscores the necessity of rational reflection (aql) on the text, linking intellectual engagement with the recognition of divine leadership (Imamah) as a core tenet of Shia theology.
